reviewed-card-sha256-algorithm: plain sha256 over the card file bytes as they stand at commit 99e9ce3 (`git show 99e9ce3:tasks/doing/385-...md | shasum -a 256`; the worktree file is byte-identical, cmp clean). This is NOT the CE canonical review digest. The card sits in tasks/doing/ with status doing and declares no blocks:, so ce task validate never reaches the quality-review-receipt check and never computes a canonical digest for it. The canonical digest was confirmed by probe to be a DIFFERENT function of the card, not a plain file digest — see canonical-digest-probe below — and it cannot be obtained for this card in its present shape without mutating the card, which would change the very digest being measured.

canonical-digest-probe.why: TASK-382's receipt asserted the canonical digest was unobtainable here. This review tested that instead of inheriting it.
canonical-digest-probe.method: copied this card into a scratch board at the scratchpad, forced status: done + blocks: [TASK-999] + a quality-review-receipt pointing at a receipt pinning an all-zero sha, then read the digest the validator names in its mismatch error.
canonical-digest-probe.observed: validator reported the probe card digests to 52e2956cfd08469dbbc0561b7f025c8d904821aa94b26688b7d4bd5122a40fd1, while the probe card's plain file sha256 was d08670646ac82ea4cb14d8acce2e68868bc45eb47193988b985843862af0346d.
canonical-digest-probe.conclusion: the CE canonical review digest is not sha256 over the file bytes. Two further probes (frontmatter-only change, body-only change) both moved the canonical digest, so it covers card content including frontmatter. Therefore any canonical digest read out of a mutated copy would pin the mutated copy, not this card. The plain digest above is the honest thing to pin, and this field says so.
canonical-digest-probe.staleness-warning: this digest pins the card as it is at 99e9ce3. Closing the card (closing frontmatter, zone move to tasks/done/) will change its bytes and make both this digest and this filename stale, exactly as TASK-382's receipt records for itself. If the card is later given blocks:, a fresh receipt pinning the canonical digest of the final card is required.
canonical-digest-probe.ce-version: ce 0.8.4 as installed on this workstation
